title: Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.34093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. translated_title: 探索像素空间扩散模型的设计因素
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们从模型架构、表示和频域三个角度探索像素空间扩散的关键设计因素，并由此提出了EiT。受去噪自编码器（DAE）通过瓶颈执行去噪的启发，我们构建了一个U形像素扩散Transformer，该模型沿通道维度进行显式压缩。在表示方面，我们发现像素扩散Transformer与潜在扩散Transformer在各层和时间步上都表现出三阶段的表示动态：去噪/局部特征扩展、基提升以及后验投影。此外，更早的去噪和更长的基提升阶段与更好的生成质量相关，而EiT通过其通道瓶颈和增加的网络深度自然地实现了这一点。从频率角度来看，我们在保持网络运行的条件下建立了像素空间与频域扩散之间的等价关系。
tldr: 该论文提出EiT——一种带通道瓶颈的U形像素扩散Transformer，从架构、表示和频域三个视角系统揭示了像素空间扩散的关键设计因素，发现更早的去噪与更长的基提升阶段有助于更好的生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EiT, a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer with a channel bottleneck, systematically uncovering key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from architecture, representation, and frequency perspectives, showing that earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage yield better generation.
